about: A field that opens a list of rows a person picks from. The trigger is a combobox named by its label, and the panel is a listbox that the arrow keys, Home, End and typed letters move through. Escape and a press outside close the panel and return focus to the trigger. A row the collection disables keeps its place, and the arrow keys step past it. A hidden select submits the value with a form.

described.about: A row takes an icon and a second line under its text, and the check keeps its column at the end. The trigger shows the name alone.
described.title: Rows with a description

grouped.about: Rows go into groups, each named by its label, and a screen reader announces the group as the highlight enters it.
grouped.title: Rows in groups

highlight.about: The row the highlight is on takes a tint, a fill or a bar at its start, as a menu marks it. Open a select and move over its rows.
highlight.title: Highlights

kept.about: The caller keeps the value with value and onValueChange, and formats an amount in the chosen currency.
kept.title: A value the caller keeps

multiple.about: With multiple a press toggles a row and leaves the panel open. A function child of the value text shows a count. The clear trigger empties the value and returns focus to the trigger.
multiple.title: Several choices

starter.name: Starter
starter.price: Free for up to three seats

required.about: Inside a field the select takes the field's label, its helper and error texts, and its required and invalid states. Send the invitation without a role to see the error.
required.title: In a required field

role.help: The role sets what the person can change.
role.label: Role
role.required: Choose a role for the invitation.

size.about: The sizes a field passes down. The trigger is a control of the same size, so a select and an input of one size line up in a form, and the rows read the body role one size smaller.
size.title: Sizes

stated.about: A disabled select dims and takes no focus. A read-only select takes focus and opens nothing. An invalid select takes the error edge, and its indicator the error ink.
stated.title: Disabled, read-only and invalid

status.about: The status sets the edge and the focus ring from its palette, the same as a text field's.
status.title: Statuses

title: Select

variant.about: The three field looks of the theme, the same as a text field's and a native select's.
variant.title: Looks
